run_resolver_component_tests: run gRPC c-ares DNS resolver component tests against a local DNS server with all test cases
run_test_with_custom_dns_server: run resolver tests by providing paths to a test binary, DNS server script, and records config
wait_until_dns_server_is_up: wait for a local DNS server to become reachable over TCP and UDP with up to 30 retry attempts
test_runner_log: log a message to stderr prefixed with the current file name for test runner diagnostics
python_args: prepend the Python executable to an argument list on Windows for cross-platform subprocess compatibility
